objective.name: Green Machine
objective.text: Win if Blue wins four missions and at least 20 Green tokens were added to missions across the whole table and game. All sources count: paid deposits, Green reserves, ability bonuses, and tokens recolored into Green. Later theft or recoloring away from Green does not erase prior additions. Your tracker shows the table-wide total after each resolution.
